title: Wisdom Council Evaluator Output
description: All evaluator outputs in the Wisdom Council Layer MUST conform to this schema. Evaluators score only the dimensions within their expertise; all other dimensions are null.

evaluator_name.description: Human-readable display name of the evaluator.

evaluation_timestamp.description: ISO-8601 timestamp of the evaluation. Optional; not required for reproducibility checks.

content_summary.description: One-line summary of what was evaluated.

primary_score.description: The evaluator's overall score for this content through its own lens.

primary_score_rationale.description: Concise explanation of why this primary score was assigned. Optional; the narrative may cover the same content.

dimension_scores.description: Per-dimension breakdown. Dimension names are evaluator-specific.

weight.description: Relative weight of this dimension within this evaluator's framework.

evidence.description: Specific, quotable evidence from the content.

value_vector_contribution.description: This evaluator's contribution to the council's composite Value Vector. Only the evaluator's own dimension(s) are non-null.

classification.description: The evaluator's placement of this content in the 2x2 value matrix.

confidence.description: How confident this evaluator is in its own assessment.

red_flags_triggered.description: Which red flags were detected, if any.

green_flags_detected.description: Which green flags were detected, if any.

unique_perspective.description: What only THIS evaluator sees that others would likely miss.

evaluator_type.description: Type of evaluator expected to disagree (e.g., 'business-value', 'aesthetic-critic').

predicted_stance.description: How that evaluator would likely judge this content differently.

expected_disagreement_points.description: Where this evaluator anticipates conflict with other perspectives. Optional; may be omitted or empty.

improvement_suggestions.description: Actionable suggestions for increasing value in this dimension.

narrative.description: 2-3 paragraph analysis in the evaluator's own voice. Captures what cannot be reduced to numbers.
